verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents an official CockroachDB Cloud MCP server. AI tools can connect over OAuth or API key, explore live schemas, run queries, and perform read and write operations such as listing tables and inserting rows. A probe confirms the dedicated official MCP server docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and evidence that it covers self-hosted clusters rather than Cloud only.
